identitySignals: Agenda names 'Thomson Reuters' in Eagan, MN; Thomson Reuters' legal copyright-contact page lists its legal business address at 610 Opperman Drive, Eagan, MN 55123

OUSD's contract is an Order Form/Subscription Agreement through the General Counsel's office; Thomson Reuters sells legal research and workflow subscriptions (e.g. Westlaw, CoCounsel Legal) to law offices and government agencies
Name matches the company's own site (thomsonreuters.com), which lists government agencies among its customers
research.notes: Agenda gives Eagan, MN, which is the site of the legal-products business (West); the parent Thomson Reuters Corporation is headquartered in Toronto, Canada. Because the contracting legal entity (parent vs. a US subsidiary such as Thomson Reuters (Legal) Inc.) is not stated in the agenda, legal name, headquarters, address and registry IDs were deliberately left null. Phone is the company's published US line.

profile.summary: Thomson Reuters is a technology and information company that provides software, data and content to professionals in legal, tax, accounting, risk, fraud and trade work. Its products include legal research and workflow tools used by law firms, businesses and government agencies.

review.notes: Agenda says Thomson Reuters in Eagan, MN for a General Counsel subscription agreement; the cited pages confirm Thomson Reuters serves legal professionals and government agencies, lists 610 Opperman Drive, Eagan, MN for its legal business, and publishes the US phone number. Summary is neutral and consistent with the About page; the contracting legal entity is correctly left unstated.
